name: Deep Space Recovery Vessel L-2783
description: The Corellian Engineering Corporation Deep Space Recovery Vessel L-2783, more commonly called the L-2783, was a small Bulk cruiser / Bulk transport designed to travel to remote locations to repair or recover damaged starships.

data.name: Deep Space Recovery Vessel L-2783
armament: Ventral mounted heavy industrial tractor beam
data.capacity: Roughly half that of a Action VI transport
